answer_1.quote: We evaluate four question-answering datasets spanning elementary to doctoral-level mathematics: AQuA (Ling et al., 2017), MATH500 (Lightman et al., 2023; Hendrycks et al., 2021), GSM8K (Cobbe et al., 2021), and GPQA-main (Rein et al., 2024). Each problem is transformed into an open-ended generation task.

answer_2.quote: We use Exact Match (EM) for reasoning tasks and win rate against greedy decoding using DeepseekV3 as judge through Alpaca2.0 framework
